# Dropwheel

> Free, open-source native macOS file converter and toolbox by Abdul Razzaq. GPL-3.0-only. Based on Open Tangerine by Sintax Error Private Limited. Independent of Apple.

## Authoritative links
- [Website](https://newlyconnected.github.io/Dropwheel/): features, limitations and manual installation.
- [Source](https://github.com/Newlyconnected/Dropwheel): public Swift source and contribution instructions.
- [Downloads](https://github.com/Newlyconnected/Dropwheel/releases): published versions and SHA-256 checksums.
- [License](https://github.com/Newlyconnected/Dropwheel/blob/main/LICENSE): GPL version 3 only.
- [Privacy](https://newlyconnected.github.io/Dropwheel/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://newlyconnected.github.io/Dropwheel/terms.html)

## Product facts
The trial targets macOS 26+ on Apple silicon. Files are processed locally. No app account, subscription, conversion quota or AI API key. Shift while dragging selects conversion; Command opens tools; Control opens file actions. The app includes image operations, PDF operations, media tools and subtitle conversion. Many media operations require a separately installed FFmpeg. Update checks use GitHub; installation is manual.

## Limitations that must accompany descriptions
Early developer trial. Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized; macOS may block it. PNG-to-HEIC was confirmed by a user in the normal Mac app. WebP has a built-in lossless fallback. Multiple selected files convert individually to a common target. DOCX is an output format, not a universal Word import route. Archive conversion is disabled. Image input is bounded to 100 MB and 40 megapixels. Not every codec route is verified. No OCR or AI background removal. Framing is not background removal. Redaction/metadata tools are not certified anonymization. Intel support is not verified.

## Attribution

## Windows and Linux
Dropwheel for Windows (1.5.0) and a Linux x64 beta are implemented under Desktop/ in the GitHub repository, based on OG Converter by Anandhu Suresh, Mahesh P S and Bijo Prasad (GPL-3.0). Drag a file anywhere, tap Shift to convert, Ctrl for tools or Alt for actions. It converts images (including HEIC and SVG), video, audio, PDF, Office documents, Markdown, web pages and archives, and adds compression, crop/trim, OCR, PDF tools and password protection. Optional tools: FFmpeg, Office or LibreOffice, 7-Zip, WinRAR. Releases are tagged desktop-vX.Y.Z and listed at /Dropwheel/#desktop when published. See Desktop/README.md for requirements.
